description:
In that village, no one questioned the rules.

At first glance, each illustration looks like an ordinary scene from everyday life. But take your time, look closer, and something unnatural should start to stand out.

Find the evidence hidden on the screen and uncover the dark tradition rooted in that place, along with the truth it was meant to hide.

How to play:
・Study the illustration carefully
・Find the suspicious clue hidden in the scene
・Select the spot you think is the answer

The moment you notice the answer, the same harmless view may feel completely different.

Can you catch every unsettling detail?
